# Solutions {#sec-solutions .unnumbered}

::: {.content-hidden when-meta="show-solutions"}
Solutions are intentionally not included in the reader edition of this book.

To build the edition that contains worked solutions, render with the flag:

```bash
quarto render --metadata show-solutions:true
```

Try each exercise fully before consulting the answer key.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-meta="show-solutions"}

Worked solutions are grouped here, at the very back of the book, deliberately
separated from the exercises (there are no inline links from a problem to its
answer). Use them only after a genuine attempt.

<!-- Per-chapter solution sections are appended here as chapters are written. -->

### How solutions are organized

Each chapter's solutions appear under a heading matching the chapter title, with
answers labeled by exercise tier (C / B / P / A) to match the problem numbering
in that chapter.

:::
